source.title: Data of Quantum Teleportation between Remote Qubit Memories with Only a Single Photon as a Resource

selection_rationale: The record is an openly licensed experimental quantum-teleportation dataset.
It concerns teleportation between remote qubit memories and therefore matches a preregistered source class.
It is compact enough for transparent independent reproduction.
Zenodo publishes immutable file-level checksums for integrity verification.
Selection was based on source class, openness, integrity metadata, and reproducibility rather than observed RTG performance.
